description: This adds more document loaders and makes it easy to add more.

comments.body: I think it'd be good to fix the version. Latest is 2.3

According to the documentation, this loader works differently:

`loader = GCSFileLoader(project_name="aist", bucket="testing-hwc", blob="fake.docx")`

Also requires a new dependency: 
pip install google-cloud-storage

Same applies for `GCSDirectoryLoader`
Did you review every loader and add the requirements needed by each?
Should we remove this commented out line?

I added this as a comment as a reminder that there is another type of reader for docx files.

Maybe one would like to choose one or the other in the future.
I did not test every loader.
I removed those - I agree that those are not ok.

It is a point of view, personnally I think it's important for the direct dependencies.  I've had an experience with version conflicts between platforms, one platform supportint version X.Y and the other X.Z.  I am setting it to 2.3 though.

Small documents could be added in addition to the state of the union.

However for testing, it would be better to have a smaller file to ingest than the state of the union.  So maybe there should just be a test-sources directory or so.
I've created a few small test files.  Should I add them in this PR or create another one?

Please remove the tests files. While I had a lot of fun reading through them :) I prefer not to add such small docs just for the sake of testing the formats. I think it is better that each user tests their own documents.

Regarding ingest times, I'm about to open a PR with a different embeddings model that makes ingestion super fast (and better than Llama.cpp). So there won't be a need for small files anymore
While I agree with you generally, the space is moving so fast that breaking changes are deployed everyday. Fixing versions may help with that situation
Please remove the two GCS related extensions
Ok, I removed the test documents.
